events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Thompson (GSW) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Green (GSW) and Hunter (ATL) engage and disengage with one another off-ball.
Murray (ATL) establishes himself in Green's (GSW) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Looney (GSW) moves toward the middle of the lane as he pursues the rebound and marginal contact occurs with Okongwu's (ATL) back and lower body after Okongwu secures the ball.
Bogdanovic (ATL) does not put part of his hand under the ball, and either carry it from one point to another or bring it to a pause and then continue to dribble again.
Okongwu (ATL) is already in Thompson's (GSW) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Okongwu (ATL) maintains a rested left hand on Poole's (GSW) right side and marginal contact occurs during Poole's drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Green (GSW) turns into Young (ATL) and initiates body contact with Young's side after his gather.
Hunter (ATL) and Thompson (GSW) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Green (GSW) brings his hands slightly forward towards Murray (ATL) and he absorbs the marginal contact during the screen.
Poole (GSW) and Bogdanovic (ATL) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Bogdanovic (ATL) establishes himself in DiVincenzo's (GSW) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Poole (GSW) turns into Young's (ATL) path and delivers contact that affects Young's SQBR.  Additionally - the contact occurs prior to the start of Young's upward shooting motion.
Bogdanovic (ATL) moves laterally into Poole's (GSW) path and initiates body contact that causes Poole to lose control of the ball after his gather.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Poole (GSW) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
